rules: CANON: AGENTS.md is the rule set and applies unprompted. If this file disagrees with it, AGENTS.md wins — report the disagreement.

PROMOTION PATH: feature branches are local only. Local branch -> local dev -> gates green -> push dev -> PR origin/dev -> upstream/dev. Never push a feature branch, never PR into main from anything but dev. Never --no-verify.
SECRETS: no non-VITE_PUBLIC_ env reference under apps/web/src, ever.
NO WEAKENED GATES: never weaken a test, assertion, lint rule, coverage threshold, or manual-test description to force a gate green.
TESTS: does the test drive a running process from the outside? No -> Vitest (*.test.ts). Yes -> Playwright (*.spec.ts). Plus the three-pass manual protocol. None substitutes for another.

STACK: apps/web is a static SPA (React 18 + Vite), no SSR. apps/api is Hono on Workers and holds everything privileged. Jobs are scheduled Actions, never HTTP endpoints. Shared types live only in packages/types.
DOCS: change in the same commit as the code. No internal planning label in anything that ships.

READ BEFORE YOU ACT — load only the row matching the task: test -> docs/standards/testing.md | git or PR -> docs/standards/git-workflow.md | concurrent work -> docs/standards/parallel-work.md | apps/api route -> docs/standards/backend.md | apps/web React -> docs/standards/frontend.md | env var or secret -> docs/security/secrets-matrix.md | workflow -> docs/ci-cd.md | manual deploy -> docs/manual-deploy.md | migration or spatial SQL -> docs/data-schema/schema.md | new constant -> docs/constants-registry.md | Dockerfile -> docs/docker.md | implementation plan -> docs/standards/implementation-plans.md | agent config -> docs/standards/agent-compliance.md | threat model / STRIDE -> docs/security/threat-model.md | role or permission gate -> docs/features/rbac.md | role scope and DoD -> .agents/task-contracts.json
